entities.title: ai-agent source
entities.summary: The ai-agent binary: the command line (`llm`, `prompt`, `status`, `prune`), the pinned model catalogue, the model store with its resumable, hash-checked downloads, the chat template renderer, the thinking/answer splitter and the llama.cpp engine, each in one file with its unit tests.
entities.purpose: main.rs parses the command line and runs `llm` and `prompt`; catalog.rs is the list of models (Model, MODELS, DEFAULT) and their URLs; store.rs is the directory, the defaults file, the model locks and fetch; inventory.rs reports (`status`) and prunes (`prune`) what the store holds; template.rs renders a model's own Jinja chat template with minijinja; think.rs splits streamed text into thinking and answer (Filter); engine.rs runs one prompt through llama-cpp-2, optionally held to a GBNF grammar and greedy at temperature 0, and streams the text.
boundaries: No other crate in the repository is used; the daemon only execs the built binary.
The engine is the one part without a unit test of its own run: it needs a real model file. Everything else is tested without one (a local HTTP server stands in for Hugging Face).
Model files and defaults live outside the repository, in ZAZZLE_LLM_DIR or ~/.zazzle/v1/llm.
